snapshot_note: UFC fighter stats updated through September 19, 2026 (UFC 331: Van vs. Pantoja 2). Includes all UFC 331 main-card and prelim competitors. Sourced from ufc.com athlete profiles fetched 2026-09-19. KNOWN GAPS: (1) ufc.com does not expose Orthodox/Southpaw stance, so stance is 'Unknown' for fighters whose stance could not be independently confirmed; (2) takedown-accuracy values from ufc.com are unreliable (several elite grapplers report ~4%), so prior values were retained for existing fighters; (3) debut-level fighters (Steveson 4-0, Baraniewski 9-0, Sharaf 4-2) have per-minute rates inflated by tiny samples of first-round finishes - treat SLpM/SApM for them as low-confidence. EARLY PRELIMS ADDED: records for Casey O'Neill, Joanderson Brito and Ryan Gandra were rolled back one fight to their pre-UFC-331 state, because ufc.com had already credited them with the Sep 19 win and that would leak the result into a prediction. Their per-minute rate stats still include that bout and could not be backed out.
